prompts:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE square photorealistic premium ecommerce hero photograph of the exact silver Xstars Messi turf football shoe shown in the three references, a matching left/right pair, no collage.
Input image 1 is the SUPPLIER reference: use its healthy restored silhouette and shaped shoe volume, not its graphic layout or copy. Input images 2 and 3 are ACTUAL GOODS: use these for exact physical construction, asymmetric sides, panel boundaries, stitch positions, silver embossed chevron toe pattern, grey-white irregular printed eyestay panel, black segmented diagonal side bands, dark grey mesh collar, off-white laces and light grey short rubber turf studs. These goods were temporarily compressed in shipping: restore rounded toe and supported collar to supplier-like normal form; do not reproduce crushed shape. Do not redesign, slim, upgrade material or invent features.
Composition: two shoes resting naturally on a seamless pale warm-grey studio floor; front shoe large and dominant in a front three-quarter view, toe toward lower left, outer black-banded side facing camera; second matching opposite-foot shoe slightly behind and offset, not obscuring the front shoe. Both shoes fully inside frame, product occupies about 80% width with breathing room. Tasteful dynamic diagonals, grounded contact shadows, no floating.
Lighting: large soft directional key from upper left with a controlled silver highlight that reveals embossed ridges and realistic fine material grain, subtle fill, clean premium sports product photography, crisp believable seams and laces, restrained contrast. Silver should read metallic coated synthetic, not chrome or smooth plastic. Visually appealing, sharp, dimensional, credible.
No advertising text, no corner logos, no size label, no props, no people. Preserve visible existing product markings faithfully, do not add new branding. Output one finished photographic image.

Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE square photorealistic material-detail photograph of the exact silver Xstars Messi turf football shoe in these three references; no collage.
Input image 1 SUPPLIER establishes normal restored shoe form. Input images 2 and 3 ACTUAL GOODS establish construction and real texture; shipping compression may be corrected to supported normal form but not redesign. Preserve exact panel layout, real zigzag stitching, raised silver chevron toe ridges, silver-white irregular printed lace panel, off-white woven laces, black side-band segmentation and matte grey rubber sole lip.
Composition: a tight front three-quarter close-up of ONE shoe's forefoot and lace transition, toe toward lower left; include the toe, its embossed chevrons, the stitched transition into the printed eyestay, a few lace crossings and the start of the black side bands. Deliberately crop out most heel. Product fills frame with a clear visual focal point; not a tiny full shoe on empty background.
Match a pale warm-grey seamless studio setting and soft directional light from upper left, controlled luminous silver highlights and soft shadows. Macro-like clarity across the key toe/seam/lace surfaces, subtle falloff only away from detail. Beautiful tactile material, fine synthetic grain, real thread and woven lace detail. Do not make mirror chrome, leather pores, invented weave, excessively embossed patterns or oversharpened outlines. No graphic labels, overlays, claims, watermarks or props. Output one finished photographic image.
